data.name: Cymbre
data.gender_notes: Cymbre is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Cymbre is a goddess of the moon and the sea, often depicted as a woman with a crescent moon on her head. She is considered a helper and protector, especially in matters of childbirth and fertility. The name Cymbre carries the meaning “Helper” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Cymbre usually hope their child will grow to embody helper and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Cymbre belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Helper.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Cymbre total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_hebrew.name: צימבר
in_hebrew.meaning: מקור מאוחר, עם פרשנות נרחבת של זמן, מודעות, וגאווה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: שמה צימבר, ישנו מקור נרחב של תרגומים ופרשנויות, אך הוא נחשב לשם מאוחר, שהופיע בעיקר בתקופה הנוצרית. השם עשוי לסמל רוח, זמן, או גאווה, והוא נהוג לציין את הספירה, ההעתק, או הרינוק

in_greek.name: Κύμβρη
in_greek.meaning: מקור מאוחר, עם פרשנות נרחבת של זמן, מודעות, וגאווה
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο όνομα Κύμβρη, έχει πλούσιο και ευρύτατο σύνολο μεταφράσεων και εξηγήσεων, αλλά θεωρείται ως όνομα εφτά, που εμφανίζεται κυρίως κατά τη χριστιανική περίοδο. Το όνομα μπορεί να συμβολίζει το πνεῦμα, το χρόνο, ή την ταξιοκρατία, και συνήθως αναφέρεται στο διαμετρικό, το διαμερισμό, ή τη διακρίσεις

in_latin.name: Cymbre
in_latin.meaning: nomen recentius, cum ampla interpretatio temporis, conscientiae, et gloriae
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Cymbre, habet originem recentem, sed in usu Christiano, est ampla interpretatio, quae potest significare tempus, conscientiam, aut gloriam. Nomen hoc, in usu frequentis est in Christiano cultu

in_english.name: Cymbre
in_english.meaning: a name of recent origin, with broad interpretation of time, awareness, and glory
in_english.long_meaning: The name Cymbre has a recent origin, but has been used in Christian tradition, where it has a broad interpretation, signifying time, awareness, or glory. This name is commonly used in Christian cultures and can be associated with the qualities of being mindful, aware, and proud

data.cultural_impact: The name "Cymbre" carries a rich cultural history from ancient Greek mythology. As a goddess of the moon and the sea, she brings a sense of mystery, romance, and gentle power to those who bear her name. "Cymbre" might conjure up images of the night sky, the ebb and flow of the tides, and the natural cycles that govern our lives.
data.spiritual_significance: To those of the Christian faith, the name "Cymbre" could evoke a deeper sense of spiritual connection. The ancient goddess was thought to be a helper and protector, particularly in matters of childbirth and fertility. For Christians, this name could serve as a reminder of God's role as the ultimate creator and provider, the protector of families, and the guardian of new life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Cymbre: From the Welsh word for "rhythm" or "music," representing harmony and divine melody in one's soul. This name invokes the idea of singing in praise to God and finding peace in the rhythm of life.

name_in_real_life.story: Grace Cymbre from Jerusalem, Israel embodies the meaning of Cymbre - "Helper". Raised in a Christian family, they were taught to honor the significance of their name and walk in faith throughout their life.
